stew over a problem: Don't stew over a problem all night; it only makes you more worried and unable to sleep.
不要整晚為問題煩惱，那只會讓你更擔心、睡不著覺。
let someone stew: Don't call him back yet; let him stew and worry for a while about how rude he was.
先別回他電話，讓他乾著急一陣子，想想自己有多無禮。
in a stew: My sister was in a stew about her job interview, so she kept checking her clothes and notes.
我姊姊為了她的工作面試焦慮不安，所以一直檢查她的衣服和筆記。
stew in one's own juice: He refused all our advice and help, so now we will just let him stew in his own juice.
他拒絕了我們所有的建議和幫助，所以現在我們就讓他自作自受吧。
stick to the plan: Let's stick to the plan and meet at the train station at six, no matter what the weather is like.
我們就堅持計畫，不管天氣如何，六點在火車站見面。
stick to one's guns: Even though everyone laughed at her idea, she decided to stick to her guns and keep working on it.
雖然大家都嘲笑她的點子，她仍決定堅持立場，繼續努力做下去。
stick together: Our team must stick together and help each other if we want to win the championship this year.
如果我們今年想贏得冠軍，我們隊就必須團結一致、互相幫忙。
stick out: His bright red jacket made him stick out among the students wearing dark school uniforms.
他鮮紅色的夾克讓他在穿著深色制服的學生中很突出。
stick around: Can you stick around for a while after the party and help me clean up the living room?
派對結束後你可以留下來一會兒，幫我打掃客廳嗎？
stick up for: Good friends always stick up for each other when someone treats them unfairly.
當有人不公平地對待他們時，好朋友總是會互相挺對方。
stick in one's mind: That sad scene at the end of the movie will stick in my mind for a long time.
電影結尾那一幕悲傷的場景會在我的腦海裡印很久。
stimulate the economy: The government lowered taxes and built new roads to stimulate the economy after the crisis.
危機過後，政府降低稅率並興建新道路來刺激經濟。
stimulate interest: The teacher used fun science experiments to stimulate interest in chemistry among her students.
老師用有趣的科學實驗來激發學生們對化學的興趣。
stimulate growth: The new policy aims to stimulate growth in small businesses across the whole country.
這項新政策旨在刺激全國各地小型企業的成長。
stimulate discussion: The teacher showed a short video about plastic waste to stimulate discussion in class.
老師播放一段有關塑膠垃圾的短片，以激發課堂上的討論。
stimulate the appetite: The sweet smell of fresh bread from the bakery can stimulate the appetite of even the pickiest eater.
麵包店傳來的新鮮麵包香氣，連最挑食的人都能促進食慾。
stimulate demand: The shop offered big discounts during the holiday season to stimulate demand for its new products.
那家店在假期期間提供大折扣，以刺激對新產品的需求。
a stinging criticism: The new movie received a stinging criticism from a famous reviewer, and few people went to see it.
那部新電影受到一位知名影評人尖刻的批評，結果很少人去看。
sting of defeat: The players still felt the sting of defeat days after losing the final match by one point.
以一分之差輸掉決賽好幾天後，球員們仍感受到失敗的痛。
sting someone for money: Some dishonest taxi drivers try to sting tourists for money by driving the long way around.
有些不誠實的計程車司機會故意繞遠路來敲詐觀光客的錢。
stir up trouble: A few students tried to stir up trouble by spreading false stories about their classmates online.
有幾個學生在網路上散播有關同學的不實傳言，企圖挑起事端。
stir emotions: The singer's touching song about her grandmother can stir emotions in everyone who hears it.
那位歌手關於她祖母的感人歌曲，能激起每位聽眾的情感。
stir memories: Visiting her old elementary school always seems to stir memories she thought she had forgotten long ago.
每次造訪她以前的國小，似乎總會勾起她以為早已忘記的回憶。
stir the soup: Please stir the soup every few minutes so that it does not burn at the bottom of the pot.
請每隔幾分鐘攪湯一次，這樣才不會在鍋底燒焦。
cause a stir: The famous singer's surprise visit to our school caused a stir among the excited students.
那位知名歌手突然造訪我們學校，在興奮的學生之間引起騷動。
stir the imagination: Good fairy tales can stir the imagination of young children and help them dream big.
好的童話故事能激發幼童的想像，幫助他們懷抱遠大的夢想。
stir up hatred: The leader gave angry speeches to stir up hatred between the two groups of people.
那位領袖發表憤怒的演說，煽動兩群人之間的仇恨。
stitch up a wound: The doctor used a needle and thread to stitch up a wound on the boy's arm after the accident.
意外發生後，醫生用針線縫合男孩手臂上的傷口。
stitch together a deal: After long talks, the two companies managed to stitch together a deal just before the deadline.
經過漫長的談判，兩家公司終於在截止期限前拼湊成協議。
be stitched up: Sam felt he had been stitched up when his partner blamed him for the stolen money.
當他的夥伴把錢被偷的事怪到他頭上時，山姆覺得自己被陷害了。
a stitch in time saves nine: Fix that small hole in the roof now, because a stitch in time saves nine.
現在就把屋頂上的那個小洞補好，因為及時補救能省去日後更多麻煩。
in stitches: The comedian's funny stories about his family had the whole audience in stitches all night.
那位喜劇演員關於他家人的爆笑故事，讓全場觀眾整晚笑到肚子痛。
